# Q-AP v1.0 - Public Playtest
**Info** [Game Page](<https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-world/blob/main-q-up/worlds/q_up/docs/en_Q-UP.md>) - [Setup Guide](<https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-world/blob/main-q-up/worlds/q_up/docs/setup_en.md>)
**Downloads** [World](<https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-world/releases/>) - [Mod](<https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-mod/releases/>)
## Disclaimer
The project status is **playable, but unstable**! If you are interested in reporting bugs and writing feedback, feel free to give this release a try. Otherwise better wait for a more stable version. You can share your bugs and feedback either here on Discord or on GitHub. Your help is greatly appreciated!
## Known Issues
- Some seeds may generate impossible or extremely grindy worlds, please share your experiences so we can improve it together!
## Location checks already available
- Rank & Level ups
- Shop Upgrades
- Challengesanity
## Items already available
- All skills (item pool depends on chosen champ)
- All shop upgrades
- Crystals, Corruption Shards, Upgrade Points, Gold

v2.0.0.description:
**Info** [Game Page](<https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-world/blob/main-q-up/worlds/q_up/docs/en_Q-UP.md>) - [Setup Guide](<https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-world/blob/main-q-up/worlds/q_up/docs/setup_en.md>)
**Downloads** [World](<https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-world/releases/>) - [Mod](<https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-mod/releases/>)
## 💡 Project Status
Q-AP is **playable** and I'm now focusing on improving the randomizer's balancing. You may still encounter worlds that are difficult to goal, you can help by sharing your experiences!
## 💎 New Features
- Hypernodes are now implemented, which should make runs easier in the late game. They are added to the item pool and once unlocked appear inside the item shop.
- Skill distribution options have been added to the randomizer, which should prevent grindy runs caused by very unlucky item distributions.
- Skills with requirements are no longer added to the item pool, if the requirements cannot be met.
- Connection errors will now be displayed in the connection screen.
- The mod will now refuse to connect to incompatible worlds.
- You can now choose an earlier goal than novice for shorter runs.
## 🛠️ Fixes & Changes
- "Carry" and "Solo" are now in the signature item pool, instead of the regular item pool
- HONOR_DUELS is now considered useful
- QBLOCK_BREAKER_1 now requires Act 2 to become in-logic
- Buffed late game corruption shard and crystal drops

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cxve/q-ap-world/compare/v1.0.1...v2.0.0
